name: finem-maintenance-documentation
description: Keep the system understandable and support safe dependency changes, deprecation and eventual retirement.

interface.longDescription:
Keep the system understandable and support safe dependency changes, deprecation and eventual retirement.

Covers: Maintenance, Dependencies, Migration/deprecation, Retirement, Documentation/runbooks.

Expected outputs: Maintenance and dependency updates; Migration and deprecation plans; Documentation and operational runbooks; Retirement assessment with explicit coverage limits.

Original skills used through Engineering Core: superpowers:systematic-debugging, addy:code-simplification, wshobson:dependency-upgrade, pulumi:provider-upgrade, addy:deprecation-and-migration, wshobson:gdpr-data-handling, wshobson:cost-optimization, addy:documentation-and-adrs, wshobson:incident-runbook-templates.

Optional specialist and framework packs: advanced-testing, intent-audit, kotlin-mobile, migration-prisma-v7, migration-prisma-mongodb, xylex-code-audit. These are selected for the project when relevant; they are not all enabled by default.

Declared integrations: github, context7, cloud-provider, db-provider. These are integration recipes, not connected services; configure the corresponding tools and accounts separately.

Why the app shows one skill: this plugin exposes one entry skill which loads the relevant original specialists from Engineering Core on demand. The Skills count in the app is not the size of the shared upstream library.

Requires Engineering Core (finem-core). Tasks spanning multiple disciplines may also require the corresponding area plugins.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project for Maintenance & Documentation and recommend the relevant original skills and framework packs.
Review Maintenance & Documentation in this project and prioritize concrete improvements with verification steps.
